notes.title: Update 3.21.0
notes.notes:
Upgrade System

 Changed the requirements for mastering the LIFESTEAL, DESOLATION skills 
 Added the TRIPLE JUMP skill
 Added to get the LIFE with points
 Added reward for completing a level without taking damage
 Now points do not expire after character death

Makeup / Bugs

 Changed a structure of level 6.4
 Changed default controls for combat moves
 Added a delay in the air near a wall when pressing the direction button
 Fixed a bug due to which the timer value was saved after the death of the character
 Fixed a bug that caused the widget to appear in a loop after the character died from presses
 Fixed a bug due to which the sound from retractable spikes was summed up

notes.title: Update 3.20.0
notes.notes:
Time Record System

 Added timer
 Added time record table
 
Enemies

 Added healthbar for bosses

Makeup / Bugs

 Changed the structure of levels slightly
 Removed part of level 4.1
 Removed shield of Green Ninja
 Increased maximum health points of Green Ninja
 Added notice at getting Life and Power
 Added hint of using Selfhealing and switching weapon for the keyboard
 Added description of icons in upgrade window
 Fixed melee attack animation of enemies

notes.title: Patch 3.19.4
notes.notes:
Changed the structure of levels 3, 5, 6 slightly
 Removed the fog at level 6
 Changed the shape of enemy energy shields
 Increased the size of knockback animation for Boss 5
 Removed the sound of taking damage from Boss 5 knockback while parrying
 Added Boss 5 knockback warning animation
 Added Boss 6 materialize warning animation
 Added Boss 6 melee attack warning animation
 The stamina bar is better synchronized with the parry and dash cooldowns

 Fixed animation bug for red ninjas on level 4
 Fixed a bug that caused Boss 6 patterns to overlap
 Fixed a bug that could allow to restore health after the death of a character
 Fixed a bug that could allow to return 2 health points for one use of LIFESTEAL
 Fixed a bug that caused the amplitudes of the jump and knockback were summed up

notes.title: Patch 3.19.3
notes.notes:
Decreased collision size of energy pillars for Boss 5
 Boss 5 energy pillars no longer deal damage during INVULNERABLE DASH
 Boss 5 knockback no longer deals damage while parrying
 Changed the structure of Boss 6 sublevel
 Decreased collision size of energy waves for Boss 6
 Boss 6 energy waves no longer deal damage during INVULNERABLE DASH
 Modified Boss 6 mechanics
 Added a time buffer at walking off the ledge, after which jumps are counting starts

notes.title: Patch 3.19.2
notes.notes:
Changed the structure of level 3 slightly
 Decreased music volume by 20%
 Increased the size of knockback animation for Boss 5
 Increased maximum range for ranged attack
 Increased parry duration by 0.5 seconds
 Decreased the cooldown of stamina after using parry by 2 seconds

 Added the option to select levels from the pause menu

 Fixed a bug that turned around the character 180 degrees after going to level 4.3
 Fixed a bug that could not allow to display the HUD hints

notes.title: Patch 3.19.1
notes.notes:
Changed some hints on levels
 Changed a structure of levels slightly
 Increased sparks size of the second jump
 Increased an overall breaking deceleration falling
 Increased breaking deceleration falling on walking of ledge
 Reduced the cost of some upgrades

 Added a small number of enemies
 Added health point drops
 Added experience point drops

 Fixed text of the exit screen
 Fixed the description of the DESOLATION skill
 Fixed a bug that could allow to perform a very high jump after bouncing off a wall
 Fixed a bug that could not allow to bounce off the wall immediately after melee attack
